definition: Beyond technology — phenomena that operate through technological infrastructure but cannot be fully explained by the technology's design or specifications. E.L.F.s are paratechnological: they exist within cyberware and networks but their behavior exceeds what the hardware was built to do. The digital equivalent of the supernatural, except it runs on firmware.
origin: Academic/street hybrid — from 'paranormal' + 'technological.' The word acknowledges that some things happening in the network transcend engineering specifications without invoking mysticism
example: Call it a glitch if you want. But when the glitch saves your life three times, it's paratechnological.
